lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ح/ي   w–ḥ–y to give a sign, to whisper, to send a secret message, to intimate
; to write down, to record; to command; to call for assistance; to go in a hurry; to reveal, to inspire.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 78 times in the Qur’an:
أَوْحَى ʾawḥā 46 times; أُوحِيَ ʾūḥiya 26 times and وَحْيٌ waḥyun 6 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أَوْحَى ʾawḥā [v. IV trans., pass. أُوحِيَ ʾūḥiya] I [with prep. إِلَى]

1 to reveal

(35:31) وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ that of the Book which We have revealed to you [Prophet] is the Truth

2 (of God) to convey a command

(10:2) أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ أَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ is it so incredible for people that We have commanded a man from among them that he should warn humankind?

3 to inspire with, to instil as an instinct

(16:68) وَأَوْحَى رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا and your Lord inspired the bees [with an instinct], ‘Take for yourselves cells [lit. dwellings], from the mountains’

4 to signal, to gesture

(19:11) فَخَرَجَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَى إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ سَبِّحُوا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا so he came out of the sanctuary upon his people and signalled to them that they should sing the praises [of God] morning and evening II [with prep. فِي] to set up, to assign, to ordain, to determine

(41:12) فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَى فِى كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا so He ordained them, the seven heavens, in two days and assigned in each heaven its order.
